profile.jobTitle: Mainframe Developer and Applications Systems Analyst
profile.summary:
Software Engineer (IBM mainframe) with considerable experience developing batch and online applications with COBOL, CICS, DB2, VSAM in the Financial Services, Telecommunications, Insurance and State Government industries, and some experience with relational database design. 
Upskilled for ITILv4, Scrum Master, Scrum Developer, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe 5) Agile Software Engineer, with experience as a Scrum Developer on a Scrum Team.
